derivations.seed_count_s: R2: |seed_asns| of the record (identical across arms and training seeds, equal to issue_time_variables.seeds_at_issue). R1: true_size - new_members of the learned-arm records.
derivations.seeds_inside_target: The 2-h target accumulates and holds the seeds (sections/03-data.tex). Checked on every R1 record: jaccard_persist * true_size == true_size - new_members, which holds iff the seeds lie inside the target. R2 records carry no target size; the identity is assumed from the definition, and the integer check below and the J == J_persist share of the learned arms are consistent with it.
derivations.persistence_jaccard: J_persist = s / (s + R), R = new_members. Equals the recorded jaccard_persist on every R1 record.
derivations.no_growth_false_additions: On an event with R = 0 every committed set holds all seeds and every addition is false, so J = s / (s + FP) and FP = s (1/J - 1). Equals the recorded new_fp on every R1 no-growth record of every arm and seed; integer within 1e-6 on every R2 no-growth record.
derivations.jaccard_equals_persistence_share: Share of events with |J - J_persist| < 1e-12. An arm that adds nothing has J = J_persist, so this is an upper bound on the adds-nothing share over all events (equality can also occur when TP (s + R) = s FP). R1 gives the recorded adds-nothing share next to it.
derivations.gap_decomposition: sum over no-growth events of (J_persist - J) / sum over all events, J averaged over training seeds per event; history arms only.
derivations.minus_persistence: paired_bootstrap of the arm's per-event Jaccard against J_persist over all scored events, training seeds then incident-day blocks.
derivations.ranking_levels: event-macro mean over eligible events per training seed, then the mean over seeds; precision_at budgets 5/10/20/50 and coverage_ceiling from the records.
derivations.p_at_10_native_contrasts: descriptive paired P@10 contrasts that include the native arm (not part of a published family), ranking_contrast with metric precision_at, budget 10.

unavailable_for_r2.added_count_all_events: needs the forecast set or new_tp/new_fp; on events with growth, J does not separate true from false additions
unavailable_for_r2.adds_nothing_share_all_events: same reason; only the upper bound jaccard_equals_persistence_share is given

reproduced: every published P@10 contrast (difference and interval) of R1 and R2
absolute AP of every arm and training seed against stratification_by_new_members
published full-target Jaccard C2 (both periods), C5@60 (R2), mean and median history Jaccard
R1 persistence Jaccard, no-growth false additions, adds-nothing share and arm-minus-persistence intervals of paper/generated/set_errors.json
